This indefinite nature of copyright protection is what allows Disney to still hold the rights to their classic characters and films. Even though "Steamboat Willie" and Mickey Mouse have been around for over a century, the copyright is still valid, as long as Disney continues to make claims about the ownership of these works. This is a crucial distinction that sets copyright apart from other forms of intellectual property, such as patents, which do have a time limit.
